title: BuildingOS Kafka event envelope
description: Versioned transport envelope for events published to Kafka (SRS-BOS-001 PF-03). Carries no invented business payload; the `data` field shape is owned by the publishing domain and defined in its own contract when implemented.

eventId.description: Unique identifier for this event instance; used for consumer-side idempotency.

eventType.description: Dot-separated event type, e.g. 'auth.platform-metadata'. Versioned separately via eventVersion.

eventVersion.description: Version of this event type's payload schema; incremented on a breaking change to `data`.

occurredAt.description: UTC timestamp the producing service recorded the event.

correlationId.description: Correlation identifier propagated from the originating request (see platform-web CorrelationFilter).

buildingId.description: Building the event pertains to, when applicable. Omitted for platform-scoped events with no single building.

data.description: Domain-owned payload. Empty/no-op for foundation smoke checks; real business payloads are defined when the first business writer implements idempotency/outbox alongside this envelope.
